name: Worthing Food Foundation Foodbank
own-page times: We are a non-referral food support service supplying fresh, dry and tinned food, as well as other essentials such as baby supplies, hygiene products and pet food to people in need. People can self-refer but other agencies such as the Council, the CAB, schools and other charities, can and do refer people to us. The only requirement to receive food is that you are hungry. To register with us to receive food support, please call or text 07526 176272 or click here. The Worthing Food Foundation operates from the East Worthing Baptist Church in Pendine Avenue BN11 2NA. We welcome donations between Tuesday-Friday 9-11am and we are very grateful for everyone’s support. Donations should be in date and can include dry and tinned food (pasta, rice, tinned tomatoes, baked beans, pasta and curry sauces, tea, coffee, biscuits, cereals), baby supplies (nappies, wipes), hygiene supplies (toilet paper, shower gel, shampoo, conditioner, deodorant, razors, shaving gel/cream, sanitary products), and dog and cat food. Food collections and deliveries take place on Wednesdays and Fridays from 10-11.30am.
